tickets.title: Support custodian account access and security case escalation
tickets.text: Support Helena Lanternmoss in resolving portal access issues with Velvet Acorn Custody after alerts involving an unrecognized device and an unknown recovery phone. Coordinate with the custodian on the fraud review process and temporary online restrictions.
tickets.evidence: Helena said the portal rejected her password after alerts involving an unrecognized device and a recovery phone ending in digits she did not know. She requested Apricot Compass Advisory support on a call with Velvet Acorn Custody to address temporary online restrictions and the fraud review process;

tickets.title: Investigate unknown external bank link and trial credits
tickets.text: Identify the source of two small trial credits labeled Buttonwood Balloon Payments and a pending external bank link on the joint taxable account activity screen. Determine any reversal requirements for the unauthorized external bank link.
tickets.evidence: the joint taxable account activity screen showed two small trial credits labeled Buttonwood Balloon Payments and a pending external bank link that Helena and Oliver did not authorize. The source and any reversal requirements remain unresolved, with follow-up needed by November 10, 2023.

tickets.title: Assemble custodian review evidence packet
tickets.text: Gather and compile the full alert emails, screenshots of the recovery phone notice, and the latest Velvet Acorn Custody message center note for the custodian security file.
tickets.evidence: the full alert emails, screenshots of the recovery phone notice, and the latest Velvet Acorn Custody message center note were not yet available to Apricot Compass Advisory for the custodian security file; the agreed follow-up is due November 9, 2023.

tickets.title: Complete household profile update
tickets.text: Update the household profile to include Ruth Lanternmoss’s move into the household, Iris Lanternmoss’s successor fiduciary role, and adjust the trusted contact hierarchy from Oliver Lanternmoss as the sole contact.

subTasks.title: Collect profile change information
subTasks.text: Request or compile updates for household members, addresses, contact preferences, employment, dependents, and major recent or expected life events.

subTasks.title: Update planning assumptions
subTasks.text: Revise income, savings, spending, retirement timing, education funding, and family support assumptions in the planning record as applicable.

subTasks.title: Identify advice impacts
subTasks.text: Flag changes that may affect tax planning, risk management, estate coordination, cash flow, or investment allocation recommendations.

subTasks.title: Confirm profile completion
subTasks.text: Review the updated profile for consistency and note any remaining open questions for the next client conversation.

tickets.evidence: the profile review showed Oliver as the only trusted contact and included Helena’s prior work phone number; Ruth’s move into the household and Iris’s successor fiduciary role may affect the contact hierarchy and planning record. The agreed follow-up is due November 17, 2023.

tickets.title: Update multifactor authentication and device safeguards
tickets.text: Update the custodial profile to reflect app-based authentication for Helena’s login, Oliver’s login, and advisor-view permissions, replacing the current SMS authentication references.
tickets.evidence: Mira observed that the custodial profile notes still referenced SMS authentication and did not show app-based authentication for Helena’s login, Oliver’s login, or advisor-view permissions; the agreed follow-up is due November 14, 2023.

tickets.title: Compare identity theft coverage renewal materials
tickets.text: Compare the Pocket Lantern Insurance identity theft endorsement reimbursement cap against Helena’s expectation and resolve the coverage choice while the account security issue is under review.
tickets.evidence: the Pocket Lantern Insurance renewal materials describe an identity theft endorsement with a reimbursement cap below Helena’s expectation, and the coverage choice remains unresolved while the account security issue is being reviewed, with follow-up needed by November 22, 2023.
